origin:
Mitsubishi Motorsport Brazil began as a passion project fueled by a group of friends in São Paulo bound together by their love for rally racing and the rugged reliability of Mitsubishi vehicles. In the late 1990s, led by local businessman Ricardo Silva, they started tinkering with Lancer Evolutions in a small garage, initially just competing in regional rallycross events. The team’s early days were characterized by shoestring budgets, late nights wrenching on cars, and a healthy dose of Brazilian ingenuity. They quickly earned a reputation for their never-say-die attitude, often outperforming more established teams with far greater resources.

The pivotal moment came in 2003 when they secured a minor sponsorship from a local Mitsubishi dealership. This injection of funds allowed them to upgrade their equipment and enter the Brazilian Rally Championship. While they didn't win the championship outright, their consistent podium finishes and the sheer determination of their drivers caught the attention of Mitsubishi Brazil, leading to a more formal partnership and the birth of Mitsubishi Motorsport Brazil as a semi-official factory-supported team. The team has been a fixture in the Brazilian rally scene ever since, fostering local talent and pushing the limits of their Mitsubishi machines.
philosophy: Mitsubishi Motorsport Brazil operates on the philosophy of 'Ginga' – a uniquely Brazilian blend of improvisation, resourcefulness, and flair. They believe in maximizing the potential of their drivers and engineers, encouraging them to think outside the box and find creative solutions to challenges. Car development is focused on reliability and adaptability, ensuring their Lancers can withstand the varied and demanding terrains of Brazilian rallying. The team culture is one of camaraderie and mutual respect, fostering a strong sense of family and shared purpose.
achievements: Multiple class victories in the Brazilian Rally Championship (CBR)
Podium finish in the Rally dos Sertões (2015)
Development of several promising young Brazilian rally drivers
Consistent top-10 finishes in major South American rally events

teamPrincipal.name: Ricardo Silva
teamPrincipal.background: Ricardo Silva is the heart and soul of Mitsubishi Motorsport Brazil. A successful businessman with a lifelong passion for rallying, he provides unwavering support and guidance to the team, fostering a collaborative and family-oriented environment.

keyFigures.name: Isabela Oliveira
keyFigures.description: Isabela Oliveira is a brilliant engineer who oversees the technical development of the team's rally cars. Her expertise in vehicle dynamics and data analysis has been instrumental in improving the performance and reliability of the Lancers.

keyFigures.name: Rafael Costa
keyFigures.description: Rafael Costa is the team's most experienced and successful driver. Known for his aggressive driving style and unwavering determination, he is a fan favorite and a consistent contender for podium finishes.

headquarters: The team's headquarters are located in a modest industrial park on the outskirts of São Paulo. The facilities are functional but basic, comprising a workshop, engineering office, and storage area. While not glamorous, the team makes the most of their resources, transforming the space into a hive of activity during race preparation.
fanBase: Mitsubishi Motorsport Brazil enjoys a loyal and enthusiastic fanbase, particularly among rally enthusiasts in São Paulo and across Brazil. They are admired for their fighting spirit, their commitment to developing local talent, and their unwavering dedication to the Mitsubishi brand. The team's fan base consists primarily of working-class Brazilians who relate to the teams' values of passion, hard work, and determination.
